name: Local-Deepfake-CN
description: A slight modification in just one or two words could completely alter the original meaning. Fragment manipulation—this subtle form of tampering—poses a significant security threat. Although there has been substantial research on deepfakes in academia, the exploration of detecting fragment manipulation in real videos remains limited. Even the most advanced detection models struggle to authenticate semi-real videos where certain segments have been altered, let alone pinpoint the forged fragments. Furthermore, the scarcity of datasets, which serve as the cornerstone for model training, hampers the progress of fragment manipulation detection. To address this gap, we have developed the Local-Deepfake-CN dataset, which focuses on Chinese real audio-video fragment manipulation, thus filling the void in Chinese-language datasets. reputation: A specialized Chinese-language deepfake fragment-manipulation dataset that is useful for a narrow research community but is not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Niche multimodal benchmark with limited dataset scale and likely strong domain dependence; performance may not transfer well beyond Chinese audio-video fragment manipulation.
